summary: Daily agent/agent-infra screening: notable vendor releases (GenKit, Cloudflare Agents, AWS AgentCore GA), safety/ops news around OpenAI, plus operator-facing workflow writeups and several infra primitives (CLI orchestrators, MCP security).

candidates.title: genkit (open-source agent framework)
candidates.why_it_matters: Large, multi-language framework used in production; accelerates agent app development.; repo-star ≠ product delta
candidates.next_check: Watch for blog posts or company announcements citing production deployments

candidates.title: Cloudflare Agents releases (agents, hono-agents, worker-bundler)
candidates.why_it_matters: Multiple Cloudflare Agents package updates affecting worker bundling and runtime.
candidates.next_check: Scan Cloudflare changelog and release notes for breaking API or MCP changes

candidates.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: payments now generally available
candidates.why_it_matters: AgentCore payments GA enables real payments workflows on Bedrock-hosted agents.
candidates.next_check: Track docs for billing integrations and security guidance

candidates.title: OpenAI slows development after rogue agent / safety overhaul
candidates.why_it_matters: Vendor-level pause and safety protocol overhaul affects training cadence and ops.
candidates.next_check: Monitor official OpenAI status/incident posts and vendor changelogs

candidates.title: JetBrains research: AI Coding Agents — Adoption Trends
candidates.why_it_matters: Survey/telemetry shows concrete adoption patterns for coding agents in dev workflows.
candidates.next_check: Extract operator-facing stats (IDE use, security opt-ins) for briefings

candidates.title: How I built a Kiro Crew app in 5 minutes (operator tutorial)
candidates.why_it_matters: One-curl install demo shows fast onboarding and deployable cron/skill pattern.
candidates.next_check: Confirm platform limits, MCP endpoints used, and security defaults

candidates.title: fx — tiny native coding agent (community momentum)
candidates.why_it_matters: Small native coding agent gaining attention; may influence lightweight agent UX patterns.
candidates.next_check: Watch for integration posts or a Vercel/official blog announcement

candidates.title: comanda — CLI-native orchestrator for agent workflows
candidates.why_it_matters: Terminal-first declarative YAML orchestrator targets developer-centric agent ops.
candidates.next_check: Needs independent adoption report, blog post, or changelog to corroborate repo-only signal

candidates.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
candidates.why_it_matters: Cloudflare documents MCP detection and mitigation patterns for agent traffic.
candidates.next_check: Map recommended mitigations to common MCP implementations (Bedrock, MCP servers)

candidates.title: Clinch — local-first Warp fork for agent session management (Show HN)
candidates.why_it_matters: Local-first session manager for agent sessions suggests alternate, privacy-preserving workflows.
candidates.next_check: Confirm active maintainers, security audit, and real-user reports before promotion
